title: Alumni Meet and IGNITE -2026
summary: JNVCKM Alumni Association invites all alumni to ALUMNI MEET – 2026, the Silver Jubilee Get-Together of the 2001–2008 Batch, and IGNITE ’26, the 19th Edition Career & Course Workshop organised by the 2011–2018 Batch on 19 Dec 2026
body:
**ALUMNI MEET – 2026 | Silver Jubilee Get-Together**

Date: 20 December 2026
Time: 10:00 AM
Venue: MP Hall, Namma JNVB
Batch: 2001–2008

Join us to reconnect with batchmates, relive cherished school memories, and celebrate our enduring Navodaya bond.

**IGNITE ’26 | 19th Edition – Career & Course Workshop**

Organised by the Batch of 2011–2018, IGNITE ’26 aims to guide and inspire students through career guidance, higher education insights, and alumni interactions.

**Organised on behalf of JNVCKM Alumni Association**

Reconnect · Learn · Share · Give Back · Grow Together

image.alt: JNVCKM Alumni Meet 2026 Silver Jubilee Get-Together for the 2001–2008 batch and IGNITE ’26 Career and Course Workshop organised by the 2011–2018 batch at PM SHRI Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Balehonnur, Chikkamagaluru.
